faq.calendarQ: Where can I find the trail running race calendar for Spain?
faq.calendarA: Trail Running Cal brings together trail and mountain races across Spain, with filters for month, province, distance and race type.
faq.typesQ: What types of trail races can I find?
faq.typesA: The calendar includes ultra trails, trail marathons, half marathons, short races, vertical kilometres, mountain walks and backyard ultras.
faq.provincesA: Public coverage includes every Spanish province, plus Ceuta and Melilla. Filter by province to view available events in each territory.
faq.addRaceQ: How can I add a race to Trail Running Cal?
faq.addRaceA: Suggest a race through the website or contact info@trailrunningcal.com. Organizers can also claim their event.

ultraTrail.pageDescription: Find ultra trail races over 50 km in Spain and Andorra. Dates, elevation and event details for {year}.
ultraTrail.pageBody: Ultra trail races combine long distances, major elevation gain and technical mountain terrain.
ultraTrail.heroSubtitle: Explore ultra trail mountain races across Spain and Andorra, with distances, elevation gain and key event information.

maraton.pageDescription: Find trail marathons from 40 to 50 km in Spain and Andorra. Dates, elevation and event details for {year}.
maraton.pageBody: Trail marathons combine endurance and technical mountain running across tracks from 40 to 50 km.
maraton.heroSubtitle: Explore mountain marathons across Spain and Andorra and find your next 40 to 50 km race.

mediaMaraton.pageDescription: Find trail half marathons from 20 to 24 km in Spain and Andorra. Dates, elevation and event details for {year}.
mediaMaraton.pageBody: Trail half marathons offer an accessible but demanding mix of endurance and mountain technique.
mediaMaraton.heroSubtitle: Explore trail half marathon races across Spain and Andorra, an ideal step towards longer distances.

marcha.pageDescription: Find non-competitive mountain walks in Spain and Andorra for every level.
marcha.pageBody: Mountain walks are non-competitive events designed to enjoy natural landscapes without racing the clock.
marcha.heroSubtitle: Explore popular mountain walks across Spain and Andorra, for those who enjoy the mountains without racing the clock.

kmVertical.pageDescription: Find vertical kilometre races in Spain and Andorra, with short distances and extreme elevation gain.
kmVertical.pageBody: Vertical kilometre races pack exceptional elevation gain into short, steep mountain tracks.
kmVertical.heroSubtitle: Explore vertical kilometre mountain races across Spain and Andorra: maximum elevation gain, minimum distance.

backyard.pageDescription: Find Backyard Ultra races in Spain and Andorra, with dates and registration details.
backyard.pageBody: Backyard Ultra runners complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains.
backyard.heroSubtitle: Discover Backyard Ultra mountain races across Spain and Andorra. Complete repeated 6.7 km loops until only one runner is left standing.

featuredEvents.burriac-atac: A classic race in the coastal hills, climbing to the iconic Castell de Burriac through pine forest with views of the Mediterranean.
featuredEvents.salomon-ultra-pirineu: One of the leading ultra trail events in the Catalan Pyrenees, with demanding tracks and an outstanding race atmosphere.
featuredEvents.trail-l-albiol: Technical forest trails around l'Albiol, with views towards Serra de Prades and highly enjoyable tracks.
featuredEvents.olla-de-nuria: An iconic high-mountain challenge around Núria, surrounded by the peaks of the Catalan Pyrenees.
